profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at DRW
profile.geoLocationName: Wake Forest, North Carolina, United States
profile.summary: Dedicated Software Engineer specializing in C#, C, and C++ in a variety of environments and layers, from OS-level task switching routines to application and UI design. Strong communication skills and does not like to leave a problem unsolved.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Risk Architect
positions.description: Skills: C# · Git · CUDA · WinForms · Docker · Kubernetes

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed applications and middleware on a variety of platforms within a global team environment. Identified and solved problems on complex systems containing over 25 million lines of code, with rigid deadlines and quality standards.

Modified and re-designed Java applications to better match customer requirements.
Added features to provide the disabled a more natural and effective experience on over 4 million shipped devices.
Integrated third-party middleware into pre-existing applications.
Learned and developed for 4 separate systems, in multiple programming languages.
Created automated diagnostic tools to enhance end-user support.
Designed and implemented new graphical user interface to enhance person-to-person communication

positions.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
positions.description:
System, Application, and tools development for commodities trading and healthcare systems.

Created remote diagnostic and configuration tools for use on deployed systems.
Developed custom communication protocols.
Integrated devices with third-party healthcare systems.
Ported real-time operating system to new hardware.
